title: FlashSpec: Adaptive Speculative Decoding with Online Bandit Draft Selection and Triton-Optimised Verification
description: FlashSpec is an open-source adaptive speculative-decoding inference engine for large language models. It implements token verification with a Triton kernel and a pure-PyTorch reference, and can select among registered drafters with UCB1 or Thompson sampling. The suite checks the output distribution with a chi-squared test. That test is not a continuous-integration gate in the 0.1.5 revision. Committed end-to-end pairs are slower than autoregressive decoding. The citable preprint is 10.5281/zenodo.20766119 (June 2026). paper/flashspec.tex is a later draft and is not itself a deposit.
notes: Metadata for a future Zenodo archive. The published record is 10.5281/zenodo.20766119, deposited 2026-06-19. Depositing a new version stays with the maintainer. Do not install flashspec==0.1.2; that package release was yanked. flashspec-asm-kernel 0.1.2 is a different package.
